case_number: 2023 INSC 790; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 4713 OF 2023 (ARISING OUT OF SLP(C)NO.17963 OF 2019)

parties.respondent: New India Assurance Co. Ltd. & Anr.

summary: Workmen Compensation Act; employer-employee relationship established per Commissioner; High Court erred by not framing substantial question of law; appeal against Commissioner order requires statutory compliance with Section 30; perversity not shown in Commissioner's findings; compensation denial reversed; statutory interpretation of 'substantial question of law' under Employees Compensation Act, 1923.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; Commissioner's award restored with interest; insurer liable for compensation.
